import stripe

def buy_gpu_hours_for_sweep(team_id: str, gpu_hours: int, price_per_hour_cents: int):
    amount = gpu_hours * price_per_hour_cents
    # Look up the customer record to get the billing contact for the receipt
    customer = stripe.Customer.retrieve(team_id)
    billing_email = customer.get('email')
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=amount, currency='usd', customer=team_id, confirm=True, off_session=True, description=f'{gpu_hours} GPU hours for sweep', metadata={'gpu_hours': gpu_hours}, receipt_email=billing_email)
    return {'payment_intent_id': intent.id, 'status': intent.status, 'amount_cents': amount, 'gpu_hours': gpu_hours}
